card.name: Linking words in old literary prose
card.fires_on: Small linking words (all, of, the, kept, half) inside older historical, literary or philosophical prose, just before a noun phrase such as war, trust, or night.

modes.label: Linking words in history
modes.description: A preposition or quantifier in a formal historical narrative, just before the noun it governs.
modes.example: the declaration<< of>> war between the United States and the United

modes.label: Linking words in poetry and old texts
modes.description: A short word inside verse or archaic or classical passages.
modes.example: That sleepen (who sleep) all<< the>> night with open eye
